items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Del Vail. I can't pronounce it French. [INTERVIEWEE] It looks like Louise Del Vail. Well, that's the way you would pronounce it probably in English, but it's French. You've got to say Del Vail.

ctx.x: Louise, I'll put it on here so in case I lose a slip of paper. D-E-L-V-A-I-L-L-E. Louise Del Vail or something. Del Vail. Del Vail. I can't pronounce it French.
It looks like Louise Del Vail. Well, that's the way you would pronounce it probably in English, but it's French. You've got to say Del Vail.
To return to this band again, T-Boy Hermes Band, do you know where they played? Or where that picture was taken? Was that some nightclub?
